title: Metroid: Zero Mission
about: All 100 items in 100% route order, and by area: 14 upgrades, 12 Energy Tanks, 50 Missile, 15 Super Missile and 9 Power Bomb Tanks.
Upgrade route, bosses, Shinespark and other techniques, and hints. Covers Normal and Hard.
celebrate:
Every upgrade and every tank on Zebes.
See you next mission.

lines: No sequence breaks needed. Items that need Chozodia gear wait for the cleanup trip near the end.
Follows Metroid Recon's 100% walkthrough.

p.x: Morph Ball, Long Beam, first Missiles. Beat Deorem for the Charge Beam (it comes back later if it escapes), then find the Bombs.
Take the elevator to Norfair and head up into Crateria for Unknown Item 1 and the Power Grip.
Back down to Norfair for the Ice Beam. The Chozo Statue after it points to Kraid's Lair.
With the Ice Beam and Bombs, pick up three Brinstar items on the way to Kraid's Lair.
Power the Zip Lines, beat the Acid Worm, find Unknown Item 2, then defeat Kraid for the Speed Booster.
Speed Boost down Norfair to the Hi-Jump Boots, then head up to Brinstar's north for the Varia Suit.
The Varia Suit opens Norfair's super-heated rooms. Beat the two larvae on the way to Ridley's Lair.
Beat Imago for your first Super Missiles, sweep the lair counter-clockwise, grab Unknown Item 3 and defeat Ridley.
Riding back up to Norfair opens the way to the Screw Attack. Then on to Tourian and Mother Brain.
After the Ruins Test your suit is back with Plasma Beam, Space Jump and Gravity Suit working.
Take back your Power Bombs on the ship, then use them to open the ship and the cliffs below the ruins.
Crateria, then Ridley's Lair, Norfair, Kraid's Lair (via the hidden tunnel by Norfair's Map Room) and Mother Brain's empty lair.
Grab the landing site's Power Bomb Tank on the way back, and the last Energy Tank next to Mecha Ridley's room.

lines: Right at the start: head left, climb over the big rock and it's on a pedestal.
The first Chozo Statue marks it. Climb the tall shaft ahead and cross the corridor level with the marker.
Your first one: in plain view on a pillar in the long corridor leading to Norfair's elevator. The room shakes: Deorem attacks when you come back.
The reward for beating Deorem, the giant worm that shakes the corridor leading to Norfair's elevator. It shows up once you have your first Missiles.
Through the red door halfway up the second tall shaft, in the big cavern with bug nests. Walk through the top-left wall and destroy the nest in front of it.
Past the bug-nest cavern, in the corridor blocked by a big rock wall. Shoot the wall down; the tank is in its base.
On top of a pillar above the acid in the corridor where you meet Deorem. It's in plain view.
The second Chozo Statue marks it. Open the red door in the second tall shaft with a Missile and follow the long route to a dead-end shaft; the Bombs are through the upper left door.
In the Bomb room, bomb the blocks under the Chozo Statue and roll left, then bomb-jump up past the Bomb blocks.
Underwater in the bottom-left of the big water cavern. Shoot and bomb the walls there to open a nook; the tank is behind the left wall.
From the Norfair elevator, go right into the big water cavern, climb to its top-left corner and up the shaft.
Follow the narrow tunnels right to a blue door; the item is at the far end of the watery room. It lets you break its matching blocks now, but only works as a beam after the Ruins Test.
In Unknown Item 1's room: once you have it, destroy the flashing block nearest the door and drop down.

After Unknown Item 1, go up through the tunnels to the open area and through the door on the upper left. Drop down the huge shaft, shoot the wall at the bottom left, and roll through to the big Chozo Statue.
In the part-lava corridor next to Norfair's elevator, sitting on a block in the ceiling near the end. Grab the ledge (or bomb-jump).
Keep going to the shaft with the elevator to Crateria, go down and right; it's in plain view at the end of the long corridor.
From Norfair's elevator up to Brinstar, go right past the Save Room and across the big room to a huge green shaft. Go up, through the first door on the left, and across the corridor.
Past the Chozo Statue that shows the Speed Booster, in the next corridor: shoot the right-hand wall near the narrow space where a Ripper flies, then freeze the Ripper to reach it.
In the big lava room right of Norfair's entrance Save Room, far right: free the creature trapped under blocks, then freeze it at the top of its jump and climb up.
In the tallest shaft, find the small ledge on the left wall near a Ripper (freeze the Ripper to reach it). Bomb through the alcove and follow the hidden shaft down.
Climb to the very top of the second tall shaft, freeze the Rippers and use them to reach the opening high on the left. A rocky tunnel leads down to it.

In the ceiling of the long corridor with the first Chozo Statue, a little left of the rocks where the Skree hang. Shoot up to find it, then bomb-jump up (or freeze a Skree with the Ice Beam and stand on it).
In the Save Room on the first left door down the main shaft: bomb against the left wall and hold left as you pop up to slide into a hidden tunnel.
Through the red door across from the Save Room by the elevator; it's on the highest pillar in the corridor.
In the tall room with the glass tube and Rippers, bomb the floor next to the tube for a Morph Ball Launcher. Launch up and steer into the tunnel near the top.
Power the Zip Lines by rolling into the conduit next to the Save Room by the Acid Worm's room, then ride the ceiling Zip Line to the tank on a tall pillar.
Once the acid drains after the Acid Worm, bomb down in the middle of its room, go left under the floor and shoot the upper-left wall.
On the way to Unknown Item 2: beat the two giant Sidehoppers to unlock the door, then roll into the glass tube for this tank.
In the corridor with a tank sealed in the roof: bomb the floor under each Speed Booster block on the Zip Line for hidden Morph Ball Launchers and blast the blocks away.
Then launch into the Zip Line's clamp; it carries you to the tank.
From the main elevator, take the second door down on the left, then left to a shaft going up.
Its base hides a second shaft going down; descend, go right through two rooms, and bomb the crumbling block at the foot of the left door.
Go down, head right at the bottom, and break the wall above the far door using the floating platform. The statue is at the end of the tunnel. It only works after the Ruins Test.
In the room right behind Kraid's. The Chozo Statue in Norfair after the Ice Beam points to it.

After Kraid, run right from under the Chozo Statue in his room to Speed Boost through several rooms into a tall shaft. Climb it, take the lower left door, and bomb the wall at the end of the corridor.

Third door down on the left of the entrance shaft, in the Sidehopper room. Clear the enemies, bomb the Zip Line switch on the floating platform, then quickly bomb-jump into the moving clamp and drop onto the tank.
Leaving Kraid's Lair, take the second red door on the right below the main elevator. Run right from the door along the platform over the acid.
At the edge, jump across while still running (or crouch and Shinespark right) to smash the Speed Booster blocks over the tank.
At the bottom of the shaft down to Kraid's Lair, bomb the floor by the left wall to expose a Morph Ball Launcher. Launch up and push right near the top to tuck into the nook.
Go right from the elevator to the end of the lava room, then run from the far left to Speed Boost through the door and down through the floor of the next shaft.
Build speed in the left corridor to break the next row of blocks, continue down, and take the first door on the left.
Right after the Hi-Jump Boots, back in the big shaft: jump over the tall wall in front of you.
Same route as Missile Tank 8, but keep the Shinespark going: in that room, re-store a charge off the slope, go around to the entry, and Shinespark back out left.
You tear through the next shaft into Speed Booster blocks guarding this tank. One of the hardest items; bombing the floor near the first blocks opens a tunnel that makes it easier.
In the Deorem corridor, run left from the rock on the right, open the door, crouch in the next shaft to store a Shinespark, and dash back to the small slope by the door.
Open the door, morph, and Shinespark left: you crash through Speed Booster blocks into a hidden room with this tank.
From the Norfair elevator, go left to the second tall shaft, climb to the very top and go right.
In the small empty room, break the fake ceiling blocks and climb the shaft; stand on the left edge of the blocks that reappear and jump to the left wall.
Go left through the acid corridor to the Varia Suit. (The Ice Beam can stand in for the Hi-Jump Boots.)
Right after the Varia Suit, drop into the acid in the room before it. Bomb the middle of the floor, then shoot the left wall to open a tunnel to the tank.
After the Varia Suit, go right past the Save Room; it's on a pillar in the next corridor.
Left of the bug-nest cavern, bomb the small room's floor and drop down. Bomb the block over the alcove on the right and grab into it before the block reforms.
At the top of the big green shaft on the east side, at the end of a super-heated corridor.
Through the green (Super Missile) door off the big green shaft: in the lava corridor full of pillars, shoot the top of the last pillar.
Past Missile Tank 7's pillar corridor, in the next chamber's top-left corner behind Bomb blocks. The floor below crumbles: bomb the far-right platform first to buy time, then run and jump over.
In the super-heated corridor below the Wave Beam's room: shoot the spire hanging from the ceiling halfway along.
At the far end of the same corridor as Missile Tank 9, in plain view.
From the Hi-Jump Boots room, take the narrow tunnel left and keep going left through the heat until you can't go further.
Drop through the base of the small shaft (the Map Room is behind the red door), go down, then right to a small room before a Save Room. Shoot through its floor, go left, and cross the corridor.
In the long tunnel with two huge caterpillar larvae. Once they're gone, shoot diagonally up at the ceiling near the second one's skin to reveal the tank.
Past the larvae, run from the tunnel into the green shaft to smash the Speed Booster floor; the tank is in the left wall.

ri_s1.s: Ridley's Lair · RI-04 · Super Missile Tank

lines: Guarded by the giant wasp Imago; beating it gives you this tank. You'll likely get it first, since you need Super Missiles to go deeper.
Early in Ridley's Lair, in plain view in a narrow hall. The four floor tiles in front of it are fake: jump from the fourth tile from the door (the Power Grip helps).
In the tall shaft with a Save Room halfway down, roll through the narrow tunnels in the floor near the two doors; it's on a pillar below.
Break into the roof of the long corridor right of the Map Room, run left, store a Shinespark, and release it off the slope by the Map Room door to smash through the floor of the shaft beyond.
Through the door at the bottom, Shinespark up the left side and work right through the tunnels. Shoot the blocks below at an angle, then roll quickly over crumbling blocks to the lower tank.
The upper tank in the same room as Missile Tank 2: stand on the middle block, clear the two blocks above, hop off before it crumbles, and repeat once it reappears to shoot your way up.
On a pillar in plain view in the giant corridor right of the Map Room.

From the tall shaft past the long corridor's Save Room, take the second door up on the left. At the last hole near the left door, drop hugging the right side, crawl through, and bomb into the fake lava pit; the tank is in its right corner.
One room left of Missile Tank 5, guarded by bouncing enemies. Bomb up through the floor from underneath.

ri_s2.s: Ridley's Lair · RI-14 · Super Missile Tank

lines: Above the room with Missile Tank 6: break up through the roof, blow the Super Missile block, roll through, and bomb the rubble in the alcove.
Next room left: on a pillar over a big hole. Freeze one of the creatures circling the pillar at its lower right and use it as a step.

From Missile Tank 7's pillar, drop left while holding left to grab the ledge by the door. In the room with Super Missile Tank 3, enter the hidden tunnel above the right door; the tank is in the hidden room above.
Next room left: roll through the tunnel and break the blocks on the left of the structure. Watch the crumbling blocks under the left edge.
Same room: clear the left blocks, hang off the edge until a single block appears, stand on it, shoot down-right to open the corner, then roll down before the block reforms.

ri_s3.s: Ridley's Lair · RI-21 · Super Missile Tank

lines: Through the door left of Missile Tank 7's pillar room (drop left from the pillar and grab the ledge), in a small room past the corridor.
In the room just past Ridley's lair, on the left. You can get it before fighting Ridley; it only works after the Ruins Test.
In the same room as Unknown Item 3, to the left past the Chozo Statue.
In the long green corridor with bug pipes (right from the lower-middle Save Room), bomb the left side of the alcove near the entrance to open a tunnel down to it.
From the Map Room, cross the long corridor, climb the tall shaft and go left. In the lava cavern, lure a bug from the pipe up under the ceiling opening, freeze it, and jump up to the hidden platform.
Easiest after Ridley: when you ride back up to Norfair, the wall on the right of the elevator room collapses. Pass the ruined Chozo Statue and head down and left.
Speed Boost left through the next rooms, smashing blocks over a Morph Ball Launcher at the far end, and launch up. Go left at the top and through the red door.
In the corridor just before the Screw Attack's room, in a ceiling alcove behind Screw Attack blocks. Grab it on the way back.
After the Ruins Test, go down to the underwater part of the next room (blow the Missile blocks by the Save Room door) and run right along the bottom to smash through the wall.
The hardest item in the game. In the big room by the Chozo Warrior's room, first blow open both Missile blocks in the shaft through the right door.

Charge at the bottom of the underwater part, then keep the charge alive by Shinesparking into slopes as you climb. Shinespark right through the door, drop into the tunnel past the Screw Attack blocks, and re-store on the small slope in the left-wall alcove.
Drop to the small platform on the right wall and Shinespark right across several screens to the tank.
In the big shaft through the top right door of the water room next to the Chozo Warrior's room: in the small alcove on the left wall, blow the hidden Missile block and crawl in.
Out the top right door of Super Missile Tank 1's room, down the big shaft and left at the bottom. It's on the right side of the lava area.
From the lava room, go left, down two shafts and through the right door. Bomb through the big brown blocks and drop down; it's behind a Missile block in the left wall.
From the ship's central Save Room, go right past the shutter room into the shaft and Screw Attack and bomb your way to the very top. Nudge the slow maintenance robot along with a Missile.

Your first Power Bombs, the ones a Space Pirate walked off with. From the ship's bridge (top of the ship, windows on the left), drop down the narrow opening in the left corner and bomb down to the open area. Space Jump over the two alarm lines.
In the room right of Power Bomb Tank 1. Lay a Power Bomb to open the ceiling; two Space Pirates guard it.

From Super Missile Tank 4's shaft, take the highest left door, climb, and go left to a narrow hall with a wall. It's inside the wall; bombing near it drops you into a pit of Space Pirates, so clear them and Space Jump back up.
Go right from the Map Room at the bottom of the ship, clear the two Space Pirates, and look in the ceiling above the damaged block at the far right.
Near the crash site: where the ship's purple hull first shows, climb to its far right edge and lay a Power Bomb to reveal a narrow alcove.

The tall blue shaft with no visible entrance on the map. Power Bomb the glass tube, go to the bottom right of the cliff, Power Bomb the wall, and follow the corridor to the shaft. Speed Boost up past the Space Pirates.
Power Bomb the glass tube between the ship and the ruins, go to the bottom left, Power Bomb the wall and drop down. Go left to the room with a big slope and clear it.
Run down the slope back toward the shaft, crouch, walk to the middle of the shaft and Shinespark straight up.

Power Bomb the glass tube, then the wall at its bottom left. Go down and keep left to a small room with a low ceiling. A tunnel in the middle of the ceiling leads into a maze; clear the Zoomers and climb to the top.
Through the left door from Super Missile Tank 7, in the huge room with packed platforms along the roof. A Power Bomb shows the Bomb blocks; work up through the maze to the top middle.
Enter Chozodia through the door in Crateria's top-right corner. In the first room after the long corridor, shoot the left wall with the Wave Beam to find it, then Missile the block in the way.

The dark hallway near the Chozo Warrior's room that sealed when you got your suit back. In the tall shaft, Power Bomb the small opening on the left wall, crawl to the end of the highest tunnel, and Missile the ceiling.

Above the yellow door to Chozodia in the top right of Crateria. Charge in the corridor beyond the door, crouch as you come back out, Space Jump to the ledge above, and Shinespark into the slope to run through the wall.
Power Bomb the yellow door on the right of Crateria's big north-east area and charge in the long corridor to Chozodia, running back toward Crateria.
Crouch as you come through the door, drop to the ledge below it, morph and Shinespark left through the Speed Booster blocks.
Store a Shinespark on the long corridor's roof, release it through the Save Room into the shaft, and Shinespark into the wall opposite the first door up to reveal a hidden room.

In the pipe room, charge again, morph into the gap by the right wall and Shinespark straight up. Follow the crumbling pipes, staying airborne with the Space Jump, then slip down past the narrow pillar on the left.
Right after Missile Tank 12: charge from the right of that room, crouch under the small ceiling opening next door and Shinespark up.

In the room to the right, run in shooting the blocks (take out the hidden Missile block), then jump just before the bump in the floor so your arc Shinesparks through the Speed Booster blocks. Very fiddly.

From the Map Room, go right to the dead end, drop through the floor and go left. In the corridor with Super Missile Tank 2, shoot open the wall near the ceiling on the far left and roll through. Much easier with the Space Jump.

At the bottom of the shaft by the Map Room, break into the lava and take the door on the left. Partway up the lava shaft, a Power Bomb reveals the tank on the right wall; mind the crumbling blocks under it.
From the Map Room, go right to the dead end, drop through the floor and go left. It's on a floating pillar; freeze a bug from the floor pipe as a step, or use the Space Jump.
In the same lava shaft as Missile Tank 13: shoot through the Missile blocks the Power Bomb reveals on the left wall, crawl through, and Space Jump to the top.
Through the door below the Save Room in the main shaft: roll through the tunnels to the second acid pit and break the blocks into a small shaft.
Run right to charge, come back to the left of the slope, morph and Shinespark right into the alcove.
Shoot a Super Missile into the floor right under Mother Brain's remains and drop into the room below.
After the Ruins Test, go to the Save Room nearest Mother Brain's corridor and run left in the next corridor to charge.
At Mother Brain's corridor, spin-jump until level with the top of the door and Shinespark left in mid-air, past her remains into the escape shaft and through the far wall.
Take the Morph Ball Launcher under the starting platform in Brinstar up to Crateria, climb, and Speed Boost through the wall into the canyon where the ship landed.

Store a Shinespark, bounce it off the slope by the small mound to keep it, stand on the mound's peak, morph and Shinespark up-left into the Speed Booster blocks high on the left wall. Power Bomb the last block.
Easier: run left from the far end of the corridor by the Norfair elevator on the right, through the next room, to arrive charged.
In the room next to Mecha Ridley's: run from the corridor on the left and spin-jump onto the raised platform by the door to smash Speed Booster blocks into the corridor below.
The corridor is full of alarm lasers; touching one shuts the tank away. Come back charged, drop down, and mid-air Shinespark right at platform height to fly straight into it.

lines: Right at the start: head left, climb over the big rock and it's on a pedestal.
The first Chozo Statue marks it. Climb the tall shaft ahead and cross the corridor level with the marker.
The reward for beating Deorem, the giant worm that shakes the corridor leading to Norfair's elevator. It shows up once you have your first Missiles.
The second Chozo Statue marks it. Open the red door in the second tall shaft with a Missile and follow the long route to a dead-end shaft; the Bombs are through the upper left door.
From the Norfair elevator, go left to the second tall shaft, climb to the very top and go right.
In the small empty room, break the fake ceiling blocks and climb the shaft; stand on the left edge of the blocks that reappear and jump to the left wall.
Go left through the acid corridor to the Varia Suit. (The Ice Beam can stand in for the Hi-Jump Boots.)

In the ceiling of the long corridor with the first Chozo Statue, a little left of the rocks where the Skree hang. Shoot up to find it, then bomb-jump up (or freeze a Skree with the Ice Beam and stand on it).
On top of a pillar above the acid in the corridor where you meet Deorem. It's in plain view.
Right after the Varia Suit, drop into the acid in the room before it. Bomb the middle of the floor, then shoot the left wall to open a tunnel to the tank.
Your first one: in plain view on a pillar in the long corridor leading to Norfair's elevator. The room shakes: Deorem attacks when you come back.
Through the red door halfway up the second tall shaft, in the big cavern with bug nests. Walk through the top-left wall and destroy the nest in front of it.
Past the bug-nest cavern, in the corridor blocked by a big rock wall. Shoot the wall down; the tank is in its base.
In the Bomb room, bomb the blocks under the Chozo Statue and roll left, then bomb-jump up past the Bomb blocks.
In the tallest shaft, find the small ledge on the left wall near a Ripper (freeze the Ripper to reach it). Bomb through the alcove and follow the hidden shaft down.
At the bottom of the shaft down to Kraid's Lair, bomb the floor by the left wall to expose a Morph Ball Launcher. Launch up and push right near the top to tuck into the nook.
Climb to the very top of the second tall shaft, freeze the Rippers and use them to reach the opening high on the left. A rocky tunnel leads down to it.
In the Deorem corridor, run left from the rock on the right, open the door, crouch in the next shaft to store a Shinespark, and dash back to the small slope by the door.
Open the door, morph, and Shinespark left: you crash through Speed Booster blocks into a hidden room with this tank.
After the Varia Suit, go right past the Save Room; it's on a pillar in the next corridor.
Left of the bug-nest cavern, bomb the small room's floor and drop down. Bomb the block over the alcove on the right and grab into it before the block reforms.
Same route as Missile Tank 8, but keep the Shinespark going: in that room, re-store a charge off the slope, go around to the entry, and Shinespark back out left.
You tear through the next shaft into Speed Booster blocks guarding this tank. One of the hardest items; bombing the floor near the first blocks opens a tunnel that makes it easier.
From the main elevator, take the second door down on the left, then left to a shaft going up.
Its base hides a second shaft going down; descend, go right through two rooms, and bomb the crumbling block at the foot of the left door.
Go down, head right at the bottom, and break the wall above the far door using the floating platform. The statue is at the end of the tunnel. It only works after the Ruins Test.
In the room right behind Kraid's. The Chozo Statue in Norfair after the Ice Beam points to it.
Power the Zip Lines by rolling into the conduit next to the Save Room by the Acid Worm's room, then ride the ceiling Zip Line to the tank on a tall pillar.
Leaving Kraid's Lair, take the second red door on the right below the main elevator. Run right from the door along the platform over the acid.
At the edge, jump across while still running (or crouch and Shinespark right) to smash the Speed Booster blocks over the tank.
In the Save Room on the first left door down the main shaft: bomb against the left wall and hold left as you pop up to slide into a hidden tunnel.
Through the red door across from the Save Room by the elevator; it's on the highest pillar in the corridor.
In the tall room with the glass tube and Rippers, bomb the floor next to the tube for a Morph Ball Launcher. Launch up and steer into the tunnel near the top.
Once the acid drains after the Acid Worm, bomb down in the middle of its room, go left under the floor and shoot the upper-left wall.
On the way to Unknown Item 2: beat the two giant Sidehoppers to unlock the door, then roll into the glass tube for this tank.
In the corridor with a tank sealed in the roof: bomb the floor under each Speed Booster block on the Zip Line for hidden Morph Ball Launchers and blast the blocks away.
Then launch into the Zip Line's clamp; it carries you to the tank.

After Kraid, run right from under the Chozo Statue in his room to Speed Boost through several rooms into a tall shaft. Climb it, take the lower left door, and bomb the wall at the end of the corridor.

Third door down on the left of the entrance shaft, in the Sidehopper room. Clear the enemies, bomb the Zip Line switch on the floating platform, then quickly bomb-jump into the moving clamp and drop onto the tank.
Through the door below the Save Room in the main shaft: roll through the tunnels to the second acid pit and break the blocks into a small shaft.
Run right to charge, come back to the left of the slope, morph and Shinespark right into the alcove.
From Norfair's elevator up to Brinstar, go right past the Save Room and across the big room to a huge green shaft. Go up, through the first door on the left, and across the corridor.
Go right from the elevator to the end of the lava room, then run from the far left to Speed Boost through the door and down through the floor of the next shaft.
Build speed in the left corridor to break the next row of blocks, continue down, and take the first door on the left.
From the Hi-Jump Boots room, take the narrow tunnel left and keep going left through the heat until you can't go further.
Drop through the base of the small shaft (the Map Room is behind the red door), go down, then right to a small room before a Save Room. Shoot through its floor, go left, and cross the corridor.
Easiest after Ridley: when you ride back up to Norfair, the wall on the right of the elevator room collapses. Pass the ruined Chozo Statue and head down and left.
Speed Boost left through the next rooms, smashing blocks over a Morph Ball Launcher at the far end, and launch up. Go left at the top and through the red door.
In the long tunnel with two huge caterpillar larvae. Once they're gone, shoot diagonally up at the ceiling near the second one's skin to reveal the tank.
In the part-lava corridor next to Norfair's elevator, sitting on a block in the ceiling near the end. Grab the ledge (or bomb-jump).
Keep going to the shaft with the elevator to Crateria, go down and right; it's in plain view at the end of the long corridor.
In the big lava room right of Norfair's entrance Save Room, far right: free the creature trapped under blocks, then freeze it at the top of its jump and climb up.
Past the Chozo Statue that shows the Speed Booster, in the next corridor: shoot the right-hand wall near the narrow space where a Ripper flies, then freeze the Ripper to reach it.
At the top of the big green shaft on the east side, at the end of a super-heated corridor.
Right after the Hi-Jump Boots, back in the big shaft: jump over the tall wall in front of you.
Through the green (Super Missile) door off the big green shaft: in the lava corridor full of pillars, shoot the top of the last pillar.

From the Map Room, go right to the dead end, drop through the floor and go left. In the corridor with Super Missile Tank 2, shoot open the wall near the ceiling on the far left and roll through. Much easier with the Space Jump.
In the super-heated corridor below the Wave Beam's room: shoot the spire hanging from the ceiling halfway along.
At the far end of the same corridor as Missile Tank 9, in plain view.
Past the larvae, run from the tunnel into the green shaft to smash the Speed Booster floor; the tank is in the left wall.
In the corridor just before the Screw Attack's room, in a ceiling alcove behind Screw Attack blocks. Grab it on the way back.

At the bottom of the shaft by the Map Room, break into the lava and take the door on the left. Partway up the lava shaft, a Power Bomb reveals the tank on the right wall; mind the crumbling blocks under it.
Past Missile Tank 7's pillar corridor, in the next chamber's top-left corner behind Bomb blocks. The floor below crumbles: bomb the far-right platform first to buy time, then run and jump over.
From the Map Room, go right to the dead end, drop through the floor and go left. It's on a floating pillar; freeze a bug from the floor pipe as a step, or use the Space Jump.
In the same lava shaft as Missile Tank 13: shoot through the Missile blocks the Power Bomb reveals on the left wall, crawl through, and Space Jump to the top.
In the room just past Ridley's lair, on the left. You can get it before fighting Ridley; it only works after the Ruins Test.
Early in Ridley's Lair, in plain view in a narrow hall. The four floor tiles in front of it are fake: jump from the fourth tile from the door (the Power Grip helps).
In the same room as Unknown Item 3, to the left past the Chozo Statue.
In the long green corridor with bug pipes (right from the lower-middle Save Room), bomb the left side of the alcove near the entrance to open a tunnel down to it.
In the tall shaft with a Save Room halfway down, roll through the narrow tunnels in the floor near the two doors; it's on a pillar below.
Break into the roof of the long corridor right of the Map Room, run left, store a Shinespark, and release it off the slope by the Map Room door to smash through the floor of the shaft beyond.
Through the door at the bottom, Shinespark up the left side and work right through the tunnels. Shoot the blocks below at an angle, then roll quickly over crumbling blocks to the lower tank.
The upper tank in the same room as Missile Tank 2: stand on the middle block, clear the two blocks above, hop off before it crumbles, and repeat once it reappears to shoot your way up.
On a pillar in plain view in the giant corridor right of the Map Room.

From the tall shaft past the long corridor's Save Room, take the second door up on the left. At the last hole near the left door, drop hugging the right side, crawl through, and bomb into the fake lava pit; the tank is in its right corner.
One room left of Missile Tank 5, guarded by bouncing enemies. Bomb up through the floor from underneath.
Next room left: on a pillar over a big hole. Freeze one of the creatures circling the pillar at its lower right and use it as a step.

From Missile Tank 7's pillar, drop left while holding left to grab the ledge by the door. In the room with Super Missile Tank 3, enter the hidden tunnel above the right door; the tank is in the hidden room above.
Next room left: roll through the tunnel and break the blocks on the left of the structure. Watch the crumbling blocks under the left edge.
Same room: clear the left blocks, hang off the edge until a single block appears, stand on it, shoot down-right to open the corner, then roll down before the block reforms.
From the Map Room, cross the long corridor, climb the tall shaft and go left. In the lava cavern, lure a bug from the pipe up under the ceiling opening, freeze it, and jump up to the hidden platform.
Store a Shinespark on the long corridor's roof, release it through the Save Room into the shaft, and Shinespark into the wall opposite the first door up to reveal a hidden room.

In the pipe room, charge again, morph into the gap by the right wall and Shinespark straight up. Follow the crumbling pipes, staying airborne with the Space Jump, then slip down past the narrow pillar on the left.
Right after Missile Tank 12: charge from the right of that room, crouch under the small ceiling opening next door and Shinespark up.

In the room to the right, run in shooting the blocks (take out the hidden Missile block), then jump just before the bump in the floor so your arc Shinesparks through the Speed Booster blocks. Very fiddly.

ri_s1.s: Ridley's Lair · RI-04 · Super Missile Tank

lines: Guarded by the giant wasp Imago; beating it gives you this tank. You'll likely get it first, since you need Super Missiles to go deeper.

ri_s2.s: Ridley's Lair · RI-14 · Super Missile Tank

lines: Above the room with Missile Tank 6: break up through the roof, blow the Super Missile block, roll through, and bomb the rubble in the alcove.

ri_s3.s: Ridley's Lair · RI-21 · Super Missile Tank

lines: Through the door left of Missile Tank 7's pillar room (drop left from the pillar and grab the ledge), in a small room past the corridor.
After the Ruins Test, go to the Save Room nearest Mother Brain's corridor and run left in the next corridor to charge.
At Mother Brain's corridor, spin-jump until level with the top of the door and Shinespark left in mid-air, past her remains into the escape shaft and through the far wall.
Shoot a Super Missile into the floor right under Mother Brain's remains and drop into the room below.
From the Norfair elevator, go right into the big water cavern, climb to its top-left corner and up the shaft.
Follow the narrow tunnels right to a blue door; the item is at the far end of the watery room. It lets you break its matching blocks now, but only works as a beam after the Ruins Test.

After Unknown Item 1, go up through the tunnels to the open area and through the door on the upper left. Drop down the huge shaft, shoot the wall at the bottom left, and roll through to the big Chozo Statue.
Underwater in the bottom-left of the big water cavern. Shoot and bomb the walls there to open a nook; the tank is behind the left wall.
In Unknown Item 1's room: once you have it, destroy the flashing block nearest the door and drop down.
Power Bomb the yellow door on the right of Crateria's big north-east area and charge in the long corridor to Chozodia, running back toward Crateria.
Crouch as you come through the door, drop to the ledge below it, morph and Shinespark left through the Speed Booster blocks.

Above the yellow door to Chozodia in the top right of Crateria. Charge in the corridor beyond the door, crouch as you come back out, Space Jump to the ledge above, and Shinespark into the slope to run through the wall.
Take the Morph Ball Launcher under the starting platform in Brinstar up to Crateria, climb, and Speed Boost through the wall into the canyon where the ship landed.

Store a Shinespark, bounce it off the slope by the small mound to keep it, stand on the mound's peak, morph and Shinespark up-left into the Speed Booster blocks high on the left wall. Power Bomb the last block.
Easier: run left from the far end of the corridor by the Norfair elevator on the right, through the next room, to arrive charged.
In the room next to Mecha Ridley's: run from the corridor on the left and spin-jump onto the raised platform by the door to smash Speed Booster blocks into the corridor below.
The corridor is full of alarm lasers; touching one shuts the tank away. Come back charged, drop down, and mid-air Shinespark right at platform height to fly straight into it.
Power Bomb the glass tube between the ship and the ruins, go to the bottom left, Power Bomb the wall and drop down. Go left to the room with a big slope and clear it.
Run down the slope back toward the shaft, crouch, walk to the middle of the shaft and Shinespark straight up.
The hardest item in the game. In the big room by the Chozo Warrior's room, first blow open both Missile blocks in the shaft through the right door.

Charge at the bottom of the underwater part, then keep the charge alive by Shinesparking into slopes as you climb. Shinespark right through the door, drop into the tunnel past the Screw Attack blocks, and re-store on the small slope in the left-wall alcove.
Drop to the small platform on the right wall and Shinespark right across several screens to the tank.
In the big shaft through the top right door of the water room next to the Chozo Warrior's room: in the small alcove on the left wall, blow the hidden Missile block and crawl in.
After the Ruins Test, go down to the underwater part of the next room (blow the Missile blocks by the Save Room door) and run right along the bottom to smash through the wall.
Out the top right door of Super Missile Tank 1's room, down the big shaft and left at the bottom. It's on the right side of the lava area.
From the lava room, go left, down two shafts and through the right door. Bomb through the big brown blocks and drop down; it's behind a Missile block in the left wall.
From the ship's central Save Room, go right past the shutter room into the shaft and Screw Attack and bomb your way to the very top. Nudge the slow maintenance robot along with a Missile.

From Super Missile Tank 4's shaft, take the highest left door, climb, and go left to a narrow hall with a wall. It's inside the wall; bombing near it drops you into a pit of Space Pirates, so clear them and Space Jump back up.
Go right from the Map Room at the bottom of the ship, clear the two Space Pirates, and look in the ceiling above the damaged block at the far right.

Power Bomb the glass tube, then the wall at its bottom left. Go down and keep left to a small room with a low ceiling. A tunnel in the middle of the ceiling leads into a maze; clear the Zoomers and climb to the top.
Through the left door from Super Missile Tank 7, in the huge room with packed platforms along the roof. A Power Bomb shows the Bomb blocks; work up through the maze to the top middle.

Your first Power Bombs, the ones a Space Pirate walked off with. From the ship's bridge (top of the ship, windows on the left), drop down the narrow opening in the left corner and bomb down to the open area. Space Jump over the two alarm lines.
In the room right of Power Bomb Tank 1. Lay a Power Bomb to open the ceiling; two Space Pirates guard it.
Near the crash site: where the ship's purple hull first shows, climb to its far right edge and lay a Power Bomb to reveal a narrow alcove.

The tall blue shaft with no visible entrance on the map. Power Bomb the glass tube, go to the bottom right of the cliff, Power Bomb the wall, and follow the corridor to the shaft. Speed Boost up past the Space Pirates.
Enter Chozodia through the door in Crateria's top-right corner. In the first room after the long corridor, shoot the left wall with the Wave Beam to find it, then Missile the block in the way.

The dark hallway near the Chozo Warrior's room that sealed when you got your suit back. In the tall shaft, Power Bomb the small opening on the left wall, crawl to the end of the highest tunnel, and Missile the ceiling.
Right at the start: head left, climb over the big rock and it's on a pedestal.

p.x: Narrow tunnels, and Morph Ball Launchers.

lines: The first Chozo Statue marks it. Climb the tall shaft ahead and cross the corridor level with the marker.

p.x: Beam shots reach across the whole screen.

lines: The reward for beating Deorem, the giant worm that shakes the corridor leading to Norfair's elevator. It shows up once you have your first Missiles.

p.x: Hold B for a stronger shot; you can also spin-jump while charged.

lines: The second Chozo Statue marks it. Open the red door in the second tall shaft with a Missile and follow the long route to a dead-end shaft; the Bombs are through the upper left door.

p.x: Bomb blocks, hidden floors and walls, and bomb-jumping.

lines: From the Norfair elevator, go right into the big water cavern, climb to its top-left corner and up the shaft.
Follow the narrow tunnels right to a blue door; the item is at the far end of the watery room. It lets you break its matching blocks now, but only works as a beam after the Ruins Test.

p.x: Breaks its engraved blocks right away. Works as a beam after the Ruins Test.

lines: After Unknown Item 1, go up through the tunnels to the open area and through the door on the upper left. Drop down the huge shaft, shoot the wall at the bottom left, and roll through to the big Chozo Statue.

p.x: Grab and climb ledges, and jump in Morph Ball form.

lines: From Norfair's elevator up to Brinstar, go right past the Save Room and across the big room to a huge green shaft. Go up, through the first door on the left, and across the corridor.

p.x: Freeze enemies to stand on them. Needed against Metroids.

lines: From the main elevator, take the second door down on the left, then left to a shaft going up.
Its base hides a second shaft going down; descend, go right through two rooms, and bomb the crumbling block at the foot of the left door.
Go down, head right at the bottom, and break the wall above the far door using the floating platform. The statue is at the end of the tunnel. It only works after the Ruins Test.

p.x: Breaks its engraved blocks right away. Infinite spin-jumps after the Ruins Test.

lines: In the room right behind Kraid's. The Chozo Statue in Norfair after the Ice Beam points to it.

p.x: Speed Booster blocks, and the Shinespark.

lines: Go right from the elevator to the end of the lava room, then run from the far left to Speed Boost through the door and down through the floor of the next shaft.
Build speed in the left corridor to break the next row of blocks, continue down, and take the first door on the left.

p.x: Higher jumps, the spring jump in Morph Ball form, and Morph Ball Shinesparks.

lines: From the Norfair elevator, go left to the second tall shaft, climb to the very top and go right.
In the small empty room, break the fake ceiling blocks and climb the shaft; stand on the left edge of the blocks that reappear and jump to the left wall.
Go left through the acid corridor to the Varia Suit. (The Ice Beam can stand in for the Hi-Jump Boots.)

p.x: Super-heated rooms and acid, and less damage from enemies.

lines: From the Hi-Jump Boots room, take the narrow tunnel left and keep going left through the heat until you can't go further.
Drop through the base of the small shaft (the Map Room is behind the red door), go down, then right to a small room before a Save Room. Shoot through its floor, go left, and cross the corridor.

p.x: Shots pass through walls, revealing some hidden items.

lines: In the room just past Ridley's lair, on the left. You can get it before fighting Ridley; it only works after the Ruins Test.

p.x: Breaks its engraved blocks right away. Free movement in liquids and lava after the Ruins Test.

lines: Easiest after Ridley: when you ride back up to Norfair, the wall on the right of the elevator room collapses. Pass the ruined Chozo Statue and head down and left.
Speed Boost left through the next rooms, smashing blocks over a Morph Ball Launcher at the far end, and launch up. Go left at the top and through the red door.

p.x: Screw Attack blocks, and invincible spin-jumps that destroy enemies.

tags: Weak point: Missiles to the eye

lines: Its body boxes you in on both sides. When the pincers twitch, the head lunges down: at first straight down, later wherever you're standing. Step (or morph) out of the way.
As the head pulls back up, the eye opens for a moment. Get under it and fire one Missile up into it.
Between lunges the body fires small spikes; keep away from the sides, or shoot them for energy and Missiles.
Three hits finish it. Take too long and it retreats to fight again later.
The giant worm in the corridor leading to Norfair's elevator. It attacks once you have your first Missiles; if it escapes, it turns up again in the corridors on the way to the Bombs.
Beating it gives the Charge Beam.

tags: Weak point: Missiles to the glowing spots under its pincers

lines: Ride the Zip Line across to start. The worm destroys the middle platform, so you're left with one platform on each side.
Stand on one side with the Zip Line's clamp on your side (shoot the switch if it isn't). When its pincers flex, grab the Zip Line and ride across.
The worm bites the empty platform and gets stuck. Turn around and fire Missiles into the weak spot.
After enough damage it makes the acid rise, then fall. Wait on high ground, and drop back down as soon as the acid clears to be ready for the next bite.
Stay out of the acid, and shoot the spores it throws near the doors for refills.
Fought after you power up the Zip Lines. Once it's beaten the acid drains, opening the way to Missile Tank 4 underneath.

tags: Weak point: Missiles into his open mouth

lines: Hit his head with a Missile or a charged shot to make him open his mouth, then jump from the platform by the door and fire into it.
He swipes with his claw and sends spikes floating at you; shoot the spikes for energy and Missiles.
As the fight goes on, the platform you've been using breaks up. The big spikes he fires from his belly stick in the right wall: climb them to reach his mouth (they explode when they flash).
The small ledge above the door is a safe spot to catch your breath, especially on Hard.
At the bottom of his lair. The Speed Booster is in the room right behind him.
The first larva: fire the Wave Beam down through the floor into its underside.
The second charges at you when you get close; back off left. Shooting its face only pushes it back.
Push it back, morph, roll in front of it and lay bombs just as it rears up to charge, so they go off under it. Two or three rounds does it.
Two caterpillar larvae in a long tunnel in Norfair; the door locks behind you. Beating both opens the right side and reveals Energy Tank 1 in the ceiling.

tags: Weak point: Missiles to the vines holding it up

lines: Its only attack is a spread of spores every few seconds; they're weak, and shooting them drops refills.
Wait for the Ripper to drift to one side, freeze it, and stand on it to reach the vines. Re-freeze it before it thaws.
The middle vine can't be destroyed and blocks your shots, so clear one side, then move the Ripper to the other and repeat.
Don't stand right underneath when it drops.
Hangs from vines in a Norfair room. It isn't gone for good: it sinks through the floor and later becomes Imago.

tags: Weak point: Missiles (or Super Missiles) to the stinger

lines: The room slopes down from left to right. Its main attack is simply ramming you.
Wait at the high left end, morphed. As it flies over you heading right, pop up and run right behind it, firing at the stinger.
When it gets out of reach, go back to the left end and wait for the next pass. Staying behind it also avoids the stinger shots it fires once hurt.
It turns green, then red. When the stinger breaks off it flies away and crashes into the enclosure on the left, opening the way to the Super Missile Tank.
Kiru Giru, grown up. Reached from Ensnared Kiru Giru's room, where it sank through the floor. Beating it gives Super Missile Tank 1, which you need to get deeper into Ridley's Lair.

tags: Weak point: Missiles and Super Missiles to his front; his tail can't be hurt

lines: He opens with a flood of fireballs: jump between them. Later he fires wavy small fireballs and straight lines of big ones.
Avoid his tail, which does heavy damage. For his pogo attack (bouncing on his tail), run under him as he bounces up and hit him from the front.
Stay on the main floor; both edges drop into lava.
When he grabs you, he stops moving: fire Super Missiles straight into his face while he holds you. Save them for this.
Don't hold back your regular Missiles. The fight is a race, and a long one goes badly.
At the end of his lair. Unknown Item 3 and Energy Tank 2 are in the room past his.

tags: Weak point: Super Missiles to her eye

lines: First destroy the Zebetite barriers with Missiles, quickly: they regrow if you stop. Save your Super Missiles.
At Mother Brain you have two small blocks over lava. Wall turrets fire constantly and Rinkas float at you; the Screw Attack protects you from the Rinkas, which also drop refills.
Break her glass with regular Missiles.

Once she's exposed, her eye opens and fires a big blast across the screen after flashing. Get out of its path (on top of the right-hand turret is safe), then crouch on a block and put a Super Missile in the eye while it stays open. About six hits.
When she's destroyed, the escape timer starts.
The end of the original mission. After her, the escape sequence starts and the story continues in Chozodia.
Later, a Super Missile into the floor under her remains opens the way to Tourian's Power Bomb Tank.

tags: Weak point: The mirror, only while it shows a symbol

lines: Watch the mirror it holds. While it shows your reflection, don't shoot it: hitting the reflection (or the warrior itself) hurts you.
When the reflection vanishes and a glowing symbol appears, hit the mirror with a fully charged shot. Each hit fills one of the four corner sockets.
After the first hit, a ghostly copy of the warrior flies around the room. When the painting glows, lightning strikes right above you, so keep moving.
Each hit shortens how long the symbol shows. By the last one, lightning also runs along the floor: jump over it.
The fourth hit fills the last socket and your suit comes back.
The Chozo Warrior engraving at the top of the Chozo Ruins. Beating it restores your suit, fully powered, and switches on all three Unknown Items.

tags: Weak point: Super Missiles to the core in its chest

lines: It stays on the right; you're on the left. Its claw swipe hits hard, so Space Jump up against the left wall: almost every attack misses you there.
It fires fireballs, and later eye lasers, in an upper and a lower diagonal. Hover around the middle of the wall's height to slip between them.
Break the glass over the core with regular Missiles, then switch to Super Missiles. You can only hit the core while the head is raised, right after a claw swipe.
Once damaged it launches three homing missiles; Screw Attack them for refills.
It changes color from blue to purple to red as it weakens. It's much tougher if you arrive with all 100 items.
The final boss, at the top of the Space Pirate ship. Energy Tank 1 in Chozodia is in the room next to it.
Run until the Speed Booster kicks in, then press Down to crouch: Samus flashes, storing the charge for a few seconds.
Jump (A) to launch in the direction you hold: straight up, sideways, or diagonally. With the Hi-Jump Boots you can also Shinespark in Morph Ball form.
Shinesparking into a slope turns back into a run, so you can crouch again and re-store the charge. That's how the long multi-room sparks are done.
You can also launch in mid-air: spin-jump and press A while charged.
In Morph Ball form, lay bombs repeatedly with a slow, steady rhythm: each blast bumps you up onto the next bomb.
Too fast and the bombs go off together; too slow and you fall. Energy Tank 1 in Brinstar is good practice.
Speed Booster blocks (arrow symbols): run or Shinespark through them.
Bomb blocks, Missile blocks, Super Missile blocks and Power Bomb blocks: only that weapon breaks them.
Crumbling and fake blocks: some floors collapse after you stand on them, some aren't solid at all. Several items sit behind them.
Engraved blocks for the Unknown Items can be broken as soon as you pick up the matching item.
Morph Ball Launchers hide under bombable floors and fire you straight up.
Zip Lines in Kraid's Lair only run once you roll into the power conduit near the Acid Worm's room.
Hold toward a ledge while falling or jumping to grab it, then climb up. It also lets you jump while in Morph Ball form.
Frozen enemies are solid platforms. Ripper, bugs from floor pipes and jumping lava creatures are all used as steps for items.

rows.s: Plasma Beam, Space Jump, Gravity Suit

lines: 14 upgrades, 12 Energy Tanks, 50 Missile Tanks, 15 Super Missile Tanks and 9 Power Bomb Tanks.
After beating the game, the pause screen shows how many expansions of each kind you've found in each area.
Power Bombs only turn up after Mother Brain, in Chozodia, and the Gravity Suit and Space Jump only work after the Ruins Test.
So a lot of items (all 9 Power Bomb Tanks, and several in every area) are a return trip. Their rows say so, and the Progress page counts them.
It's common to beat the game once you reach Chozodia and sweep up the rest afterward.

h_unknown.s: Plasma Beam, Space Jump, Gravity Suit

lines: The three Unknown Items can't be used when you find them, but each one already breaks the blocks engraved with its picture.
Beating the Ruins Test restores your suit and switches all three on.
Enemies hit harder and are placed differently.
Expansions give half as much: an Energy Tank adds 50, a Missile Tank 2, a Super Missile or Power Bomb Tank 1.
Only what each expansion gives changes, not where it is, so this guide covers both modes.
After Mother Brain, Samus crash-lands and has to sneak through the Space Pirate ship without her Power Suit.
Chozodia's items are collected once your suit is restored at the Ruins Test, so don't worry about missing them on the way in.
